files.description:
Act III of The Cosmos: A Space Novella

Radio silence... angry bursts of steam hiss out from giant bubbles of green toxic sludge, bulging up and escaping like puss from a scab.

Somewhere amongst the rubble, Captain Sergey lies lifeless surrounded by a halo of snow-like orbs, creating a magical aura
